channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran war: US strategic success or diplomatic failure?
item.description: Marc Lamont Hill challenges former United States diplomat Heino Klinck on the US-Israeli war in Iran.

item.title: Israeli forces kill five Palestinians in latest attacks on Gaza
item.description: Since a US-brokered ceasefire in October, Israeli attacks have killed at least 1,098 Palestinians in Gaza.

item.title: US insists Strait of Hormuz is open as it exchanges strikes with Iran
item.description: Iranian forces earlier said the Strait was closed and launched wide-ranging attacks at US allies and bases in the region.

item.title: At least two killed in Toronto street festival shooting
item.description: Police say there was an exchange of gunfire between two individuals at the festival, and two firearms had been recovered from the scene.

item.title: US Democrat Ro Khanna says he was detained by armed Israeli settlers
item.description: Khanna, 49, was visiting the occupied West Bank when he was held for 90 minutes, he says.

item.title: Indian tourists among 15 killed as speedboat capsizes in Vietnam
item.description: Local media say 21 people were saved after the boat overturned in rough seas near an island in south Vietnam.
